hypothesis: Adding frozen Matérn changepoint age and evidence score to the same small trend LSTM improves one-day volatility-scaled return prediction across project-seen chronological blocks.

paper.published_domain: 50 traditional continuous futures, Pinnacle CLC 1990-2020; not crypto

source.warmup: 2020 causal context and asset-specific natural warmup; gaps reset EWM; no bfill
source.availability: daily bar start + 86400000000us; completed-day historical proxy, actual publication latency UNKNOWN
source.raw_source_verification: REUSED archive/member hashes; prior producer receipts, no new original exchange ZIP recertification

training.loss: MSE of next daily close-to-close return / causal 60-day EWM std
training.readout: last LSTM hidden + linear prediction; no tanh position
training.sample_order: same seeded replacement minibatches per pair; overlapping windows explicit
training.scaler: unique training input rows including only their past 63-day contexts
training.maturity: label_end strictly less than split_end; equality purged; one-day horizon

pair: Identical 10-input parameter axes and seeded initial state; baseline uses eight trend inputs plus two constant-zero channels; treatment uses the same trends plus age/severity; identical sample rows and update count.

gp.selection: evenly spaced finite training windows, no outcome selection
gp.parameters: independent left/right Matérn variance and length, shared CP noise, sigmoid steepness; stationary variance/length/noise; global train-only return mean/std
gp.likelihood: independent per-asset windows; fixed-prior CP grid marginal likelihood
gp.location_feature: posterior mean age=(21-c)/21; official code orientation, opposite paper gamma
gp.severity: sigmoid(NLML_M - NLML_CP_mixture); evidence score, not changepoint probability
gp.inference: fixed covariance likelihoods; no optimizer, parameter or scaler fit on validation
gp.nonconvergence: retain finite capped optimizer terminal parameters and report status; no retry or iteration extension

all_required: ensemble MSE skill versus trend positive in at least 2 of 3 blocks
aggregate MSE improvement positive in at least 2 of 3 paired seeds
95% moving-block bootstrap lower bound of date-mean loss improvement positive
unweighted mean block daily-rank-IC increment at least 0.01
prediction_gate.interpretation: Development screening with conditional uncertainty; no pristine OOS or effective-independent-N claim
prediction_gate.failure_action: STOP; no further fits, alternative horizon, seed choice, CP window search or wallet profit claims

economic_stage.scope: existing recovered frozen shared-wallet engine with exact actual funding and native trade/mark availability; never substitute a daily toy account
economic_stage.missing_data_action: report blocker, preserve code/tests; never fabricate Q1/Q2 2026 ledgers or zero funding

deviations_from_paper: crypto historical data instead of original CLC futures
supervised prediction MSE instead of pooled Sharpe position loss
frozen global training scaling instead of per-window refit
frozen GP covariance parameters and six-position posterior grid instead of online continuous location/kernel optimization
fixed 256 updates and 3 seeds, no 50-trial hyperparameter search
sliding overlapping 63-day supervised sequences instead of nonoverlapping paper training
causal warmup with no backward fill; no winsorisation
last linear readout instead of time-distributed tanh positions
one fixed chronological train period and three old-history validation blocks

boundaries.other_distribution_study: isolated branch, modules and state; no edits

attempt_accounting: one real scientific attempt; six paired model fits plus one GP group; synthetic tests separate; source/data/config SHA receipts; no rescore-based recipe changes
